grant_note: 8,824.71-acre Mexican land grant to Juan Maria Osuna (Alvarado 1840/41 + Pico 11 Aug 1845). Patented 18 Apr 1871 to Juliana Lopez Osuna et al. Renamed Rancho Santa Fe by the Santa Fe Land Improvement Co. in 1922. Grantee/owner families: Osuna, Ruiz (Juana Ruiz / Osuna family ties). DISTINCT from any Orange County land of similar name.
